# google_storage_insights_dataset_config

Get information about a Cloud Storage Insights DatasetConfig.


For more information see the [official documentation](https://cloud.google.com/storage/docs/insights/datasets) and
the [API](https://cloud.google.com/storage/docs/insights/reference/rest/v1/projects.locations.datasetConfigs).

## Example Usage

```hcl
data "google_storage_insights_dataset_config" "default" {
  location = google_storage_insights_dataset_config.config_includes.location
  dataset_config_id = google_storage_insights_dataset_config.config_includes.dataset_config_id
}
```

## Argument Reference

The following arguments are supported:



* `location` -
  (Required)
  The location of the DatasetConfig.

* `dataset_config_id` -
  (Required)
  The user-defined ID of the DatasetConfig


* `project` - (Optional) The ID of the project in which the resource belongs.
    If it is not provided, the provider project is used.
